_comment: Reward events (docs/gameplay/07 phase 6; src/core/game/systems/mini_game.h): a timing game that earns gold or crystals,
started from any dialogue choice: {"type": "miniGame", "id": "<key here>"}. The play is Battle v3's point play:
points (1-5) on a track, a marker sweeping it (sweepMs; turnBack; maxSweeps), a tap within hitWindow of a point hits
it. Each hit earns perHit of the currency (gold or crystals), every point hit bonusAll more; two misses in a row end
it with nothing. limit: plays a run (0: no limit). title / text: per language; a language missing falls back (en,
then any), so crystal_shrine, written in Traditional Chinese only, shows Chinese in every language (the owner's test).

text.zh_TW: 行商的寶箱鎖住了。撬開鎖芯：標記經過每個鎖栓時點擊。撬開幾個，就分你幾份金幣。
text.en: The peddler's chest is locked. Pick it: tap as the marker passes each pin. Every pin you free earns you a share of gold.

text.zh_TW: 古老的祭壇上浮著三顆微光。光點掠過時，以指尖輕觸，就能凝出水晶。全部凝成，祭壇會多贈一顆。
